headline: Sibelyx ice worker
title: Sibelyx | Medicine Cooling Farming | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a cool all rounder in Palworld one point zero? Sibelyx is an Ice Pal that works Medicine Production level three, Cooling level three and Farming level three. You can find it around the Astral Mountains, and its alpha is a level forty boss. Will you set Sibelyx to work in your lab? Comment below!
description: Sibelyx in Palworld 1.0 is an Ice Pal with Medicine, Cooling and Farming all at level three, found in the Astral Mountains.
joke: Sibelyx keeps the base nice and cool.
